skills.name: gjalla-breakdown
skills.description: Break a feature spec into intentional waves and bite-sized tasks grouped by dependency. Use after a spec is written to prepare for easy-to-track implementation.

skills.name: gjalla-cleanup-audit
skills.description: Audit a codebase for dead code, unreachable branches, duplicated logic, and vestigial abstractions, then remove them safely with proof. Use to reduce sprawl, pay down tech debt, or clean up after a feature is retired or migrated.

skills.name: gjalla-code-review
skills.description: Review a code change (diff or PR) for ship-readiness before merge. Use when reviewing your own or someone else's changes prior to committing/merging/etc.

skills.name: gjalla-debug
skills.description: Investigate a reported problem down to its root cause, with evidence, before proposing a fix. Use when something is broken, behaving unexpectedly, or a user reports an issue you can't immediately explain.
headings: 2. Reproduce it, or say plainly that you couldn't
3. Check that what you're reading is current
5. Separate what you observed from what you inferred
6. Find the root cause, not the first thing that would make the symptom go away
7. Enumerate the shape of the bug across the tree

skills.name: gjalla-onboard
skills.description: Set up gjalla for rich coding agent telemetry and insights as well as durable memory to improve your metrics. Use when asked to install, set up, onboard, or backfill gjalla.
headings: 0. gjalla scope and orienting your position
What belongs, and what does not

skills.name: gjalla-prepare-and-commit
skills.description: Make sure your code is ready to commit, then stage changes into clean, atomic commit. Use before committing.
headings: 2. Present the process (the second human gate)

skills.name: gjalla-spec-review
skills.description: Full review of a plan or spec to be sure there are no surprises, gaps, or mistakes. Use to harden a spec before implementation.
headings: Architect Review (reference the gjalla master spec where needed)

skills.name: gjalla-spec
skills.description: Create a well-thought-out plan covering problem statement, goals, technical approach, and verification criteria. Use while planning / before implementing any non-trivial feature.

skills.name: gjalla-test-audit
skills.description: Audit a test suite to find tests that give false confidence — tests that encode bugs, duplicate coverage, or are so heavily mocked they can't catch real regressions. Use to improve robustness, audit coverage, or harden a risky area.
